Traveling Instructions for Saints who are attending the Sant Samagam at Sangli :
By Railway the nearest stations are Sangli Railway Station and Miraj Junction :
Miraj ST Bus Stand is 500 meters (7 minutes walk).
Take any ST bus to Ashta / Islampur → direct drop at venue.
Auto rickshaw: To Islampur Road (near Lokare Petrol Pump), 7 km, fare ₹150–₹200.
No direct buses currently; Special ST / MSRTC buses from Sangli & Miraj depots to Ashta / Islampur will drop at venue.

By Private Transport Buses from Mumbai / Pune / Kolhapur :

From any district of Maharashtra, to go directly to the Samagam venue, S.T Group booking option of S.T buses is available. For this S.T. arrangements have been made to provide this facility to the entire Maharashtra by correspondence of the MSRTC Central Office in Mumbai.

Under this facility, a group of at least 44 saints will have to be prepared for one bus. At the samagam venue S.T. The MSRTC office will be built so that a return journey group booking facility will be available. This facility will also be available to the saints going for pre-samagam services.

In order to make proper arrangements for the saints coming to the Samagam, write the details of the number of coming saints from your area or branch, details of their journey i.e. name and number of bus, railway, or airplane etc., date and time etc. to the email ID- Please send it to
Please note that in the absence of this information, it is difficult to properly manage accommodation and free buses etc. at the venue of the Samagam.
Sangli experiences cold weather in the month of January. Finally, the saints should carry warm clothes/bedding etc. as per requirement.
There are no accommodation facilities in Sangli Bhavan:
, no accommodation will be available in any of the satsang bhavans in Sangli.
Ultimately, no zonal in-charge, coordinator or Mukhi Mahatma should give any letter or permission to stay at any Bhavan premises in Sangli during this period.

Residential arrangements for the Mahatmas coming for the Samagam have been made at the Samagam venue. So, may be Delhi or any other place, any saint should please reach the venue of the samagam directly.
Appropriate parking arrangements will be made at the venue for the saints who reach the venue directly in their own vehicles and private buses.
Avoid to descend on Highway (As No space for Parking of Vehicles).
Traffic Route Sewadal will guide for route towards parking.
